name: Tojima Wants to Be a Kamen Rider
description: Even after turning 40 years old, Tojima Tanzaburo still seriously wants to be a Kamen Rider. Just when it seems like his dream may never come true, he gets caught up in a series of infamous Shocker-inspired robberies... Shibata Yokusaru, the author of Air Master and 81 Diver, presents a story about adults who love Kamen Rider a little too much, and start playing pretend... for real!

videos.title: Tojima Wants to Be a Kamen Rider
videos.overview: Tanzaburo Tojima has always idolized Kamen Rider, to the point of wanting to be him. He turns 40 this year...

videos.title: I Am Tackle
videos.overview: Yuriko Okada has always idolized Electro-Wave Human Tackle. But seeing Tojima forces her into action...

videos.title: I Love the Moment When Hate Turns to Love
videos.overview: After their encounter with the real Shocker, Tojima meets someone who knows more about the evil organization.

videos.title: Who Is the Strongest Kamen Rider?
videos.overview: Mitsuba's girlfriend, Yukarisu, transforms into a Shocker Combatant and attacks Yuriko!

videos.title: Let Me Be V3 Too
videos.overview: Mitsuba's girlfriend, Yukarisu, is a member of Shocker. What will he do protect her from his brother, Ichiyo?

videos.title: Order Some Snacks
videos.overview: The gang gathers at a pub to discuss what's happened. But it's owner is Ichiyo and Mitsuba's resentful sister.

videos.title: Let Me Join Shocker
videos.overview: Nakao has a fateful encounter that makes him recount how he ended up as a Shocker-idolizing yakuza.

videos.title: What's a Kamen Rider Do When A Dangerous Enemy Appears?
videos.overview: Tojima and the gang now know that both Shocker and monsters are real. What's next?

videos.title: Show Me Your Rider
videos.overview: The tournament to decide the strongest begins, with Yukarisu and Tojima facing off.

videos.title: Risk Your Life
videos.overview: Yuriko and Tojima clash, with her superior technique frustrated by his bottomless resilience and power...

videos.title: Tackle is the Strongest
videos.overview: Both worn out from their previous battles, the tournament concludes with Mitsuba VS Yuriko.

videos.title: I'll Take All You Riders On
videos.overview: The gang has an unexpected encounter at Futaba's pub.

videos.title: I Will Fight, and Die, Against Shocker
videos.overview: Futaba's rage towards her brother, Ichiyo, reaches it's breaking point.

videos.title: I Want to Learn More About Humans
videos.overview: Will Futaba still be able to deny the existence of Shocker when she finds herself in a fight against Kumota?

videos.title: The Masked Idol, Heavy Chop
videos.overview: An encounter with a man from Sena's past deepens Kumota's curiosity about humans.

videos.title: An Imposter Can't Beat the Real Deal
videos.overview: Thunder Raiko finally comes for Yukarisu. Will the Riders be able to protect her from the Shocker assassin?

videos.title: Everyone In The World Will Join Shocker
videos.overview: Tojima reels from the most recent battle, while Ito, Sato, and Ishige stumble onto Bat Man's wicked plot...

videos.title: I'll Fight Shocker Too
videos.overview: Nakao and his underlings find a surprising sanctuary, as the Bat Man's Shocker idols continue to hunt them.

videos.title: It'd Be an Honor to Die as a Rider
I Was Craving a Battle With Shocker
videos.overview: Ichiyo introduces Nakao to someone who seems poised to figure out what it is he's lacking.

videos.title: Becoming the Ultimate Monster
videos.overview: Thunder Raiko tracks Nakao down, but his training has made him more than she can handle at first.

videos.title: Shocker is on the Move
videos.overview: Tojima and his fellow Riders unite, out to stop the Bat Man's mass recruitment scheme for Shocker.

videos.title: Let's Do This, Shocker!
videos.overview: The Bat Man intends to convert every visitor at an arena into a Shocker Combatant. Can the Riders stop him?

videos.title: I Wouldn't Mind Dying Today
videos.overview: Tojima and the Riders finally square off against the Bat Man. But can humans really defeat a Shocker monster?
